audit.why: Jax owns every row through first item and Yi only takes 2+ items. Full phases[].side and content win[] agree row-for-row, match the packet chart, and the 44.48% record is the inverse of the 55.52% the Jax-side mirror reports.
Four spikes placed at 3-5, level 6, first item and late, and breakdown.spikes correctly names his level 3, level 6 and Sheen timings against Yi's single two-item spike.
audit.corrected: Counter Strike's real cooldown range added — see point 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slot and name errors: whys[1] calls Counter Strike his W (it is E, and he does not have it at level 2 — his level 2 threat is Empower); whys[4] and spikes[1] call his ult 'Grandmaster's Might' when Riot's name is Grandmaster-at-Arms; spikes[0] warns about melee 'while his W is up' when the ability that punishes melee is E; wants.foe[1] credits 'on-hit E stacks' when the attack-speed stacking is his passive Relentless Assault and the bonus magic damage is his R's third attack. Nowhere does the entry say the Counter Strike stun cancels Meditate.
audit.why: This is the one lane where Meditate is the player's whole survival plan pre-item, and the entry recommends sustaining without ever saying the stun cuts the channel. Counter Strike is hard CC, Meditate is a channel — it does not just get out-damaged, it stops.
audit.corrected: Slots and ult name fixed in whys[1], whys[4], spikes[0], spikes[1], wants.foe[1]; Meditate cancellation written into spikes[0], spikes[2], dontsFull[0] and report[5].
sources: brief enemyKit slot text and names

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns says to trade 'in the ~8-10s window after he uses it'. Counter Strike is 17s at rank 1 and only reaches 9s at rank 5, so for the whole early lane the entry understates the punish window by roughly half.
audit.why: This is the single most valuable number in the matchup: at level 3 a whiffed or spent Counter Strike leaves Jax without his answer for 17 seconds, which is long enough to actually do something rather than the near-instant window the text implies.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with 17s at rank 1 down to 9s maxed.

edits.before: Track Counter Strike (E) above all — it is the entire matchup. Never throw autos or commit Alpha Strike into an active or available E; only trade in the ~8-10s window after he uses it.
edits.after: Track Counter Strike (E) above all — it is the entire matchup, and at rank 1 it is down for 17s, reaching 9s when maxed. Never commit autos or Alpha Strike into an available E; trade in that window.

edits.before: If you blink in while Counter Strike is up he dodges your hits and stuns you with no escape off cooldown — it's a free kill for him every time.
edits.after: If you blink in while Counter Strike is up he dodges your hits, stuns you, cancels any Meditate, and you have no escape off cooldown — a free kill.

edits.before: Counter Strike dodges your autos and Alpha Strike on-hits and stuns you — it hard-counters your kit; conversely Alpha Strike's untargetability can dodge his stun if you time the blink into his E cast, and Wuju Style true damage ignores the bonus armor his R provides.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges your autos and Alpha Strike on-hits, stuns you, and cancels Meditate mid-channel — it hard-counters your kit; conversely Alpha Strike's untargetability can dodge the stun if you time the blink into his E, and Wuju true damage ignores the armour his R gives.

edits.before: Jax gains W Counter Strike and dominates level 2 melee.
edits.after: Jax's Empower (W) burst dominates the level 2 melee trade.

edits.before: Jax's level-6 Grandmaster's Might resists beat your stat-only R.
edits.after: Jax's level-6 Grandmaster-at-Arms resists beat your stat-only R.

edits.before: Jax's Leap Strike into Empower burst plus his Counter Strike stun shreds you if you try to E-trade; never sit in melee while his W is up.
edits.after: Leap Strike into Empower plus the Counter Strike stun shreds you, and that stun cancels Meditate — never stand in melee while his E is up.

edits.before: Jax ults for the Grandmaster's Might resists and on-hit magic damage, turning every extended fight in his favor while your R is only stat steroids.
edits.after: Jax ults for Grandmaster-at-Arms resists and third-attack magic damage, turning every extended fight his way while your R is only stat steroids.

edits.before: Jax spikes hard on Trinity Force or Blade of the Ruined King and can all-in you through Meditate; farm safe and don't duel.
edits.after: Jax spikes hard on Trinity Force or Blade of the Ruined King, and his stun cancels Meditate outright; farm safe and don't duel.

edits.before: Trade in melee where Empower + on-hit E stacks stomp you
edits.after: Trade in melee where Empower and ramping attack speed win

notes: The load-bearing fix is the cooldown: the page told the player to trade in an '~8-10s window' after Counter Strike, but at rank 1 it is 17s. Through the levels where Yi is most desperate for a punish window, the page was telling him it was half as long as it really is. Second: Counter Strike is hard CC and Meditate is a channel, so the sustain plan the entry recommends does not survive contact with his E — now stated in four places. Level chart untouched and consistent across both layers.
